global_rules.inventory_distribution: Inventory must be distributed across all 12 stores, respecting Store_Type assortment limits.

product_category_rules.perishable_flag_handling: Read 'base_shelf_life_days' and 'storage_type' from products.csv. Do NOT re-classify manually. Treat items with base_shelf_life_days <= 180 as strictly perishable for FEFO.

reorder_level_rules.Fast: Calculate as 30% of the upper bound of the category's stock rule.
reorder_level_rules.Medium: Calculate as 25% of the upper bound of the category's stock rule.
reorder_level_rules.Slow: Calculate as 20% of the upper bound of the category's stock rule.

Last_Restock_Date.logic: Random date within the previous 30 days from the baseline simulation date.

batch_rules.description: Unique identifier for every distinct product delivery batch. E.g., B250401001 for April 1, 2025, batch 1.

perishable.logic: Expiry_Date = Last_Restock_Date + Remaining Shelf Life where Remaining Shelf Life is randomly generated within a realistic percentage of the product's base shelf life.

business_rules.name: Temperature Control Guardrail
business_rules.logic: IF products.csv indicates storage_type IN ['Refrigerated', 'Frozen'] THEN Store_ID MUST have Temperature_Control == TRUE.

business_rules.name: Assortment Depth by Store Type
business_rules.logic: Micro stores stock 55-65% of total SKUs. Medium stores stock 70-80% of total SKUs. Large stores stock 85-95% of total SKUs.

business_rules.name: Premium Location Assortment
business_rules.logic: Stores in ['Whitefield', 'Indiranagar', 'Koramangala', 'HSR Layout'] have a 40% higher probability of stocking products with 'tier' == 'Premium'.

business_rules.name: Budget Location Assortment
business_rules.logic: Stores in ['Electronic City', 'Yelahanka', 'Rajajinagar'] have a 30% higher probability of stocking products with 'tier' == 'Budget'.

business_rules.name: Capacity Ceiling
business_rules.logic: Total Current_Stock sum across all products for a specific Store_ID MUST NOT exceed its Storage_Capacity from darkstores.csv.

business_rules.name: FEFO Enforcement Principle
business_rules.logic: Inventory batches with earlier Expiry_Date values must be mathematically prioritized for downstream order allocation.

business_rules.name: Out of Stock Urgent Replenishment
business_rules.logic: IF Inventory_Status == 'Out of Stock' THEN Next_Restock_Date must always be scheduled within 48 hours.

validation_rules: Batch_ID must be strictly unique per product delivery.
Inventory_Status MUST mathematically match the Current_Stock vs Reorder_Level logic.
Expiry_Date is required for perishable items and 'Not Applicable' for non-perishables.
The number of unique Product_IDs stocked in a Store_ID must never exceed the assortment capacity permitted for that Store_Type.
